about: Photo coverage (docs/PHOTO_COVERAGE_PRD.md, scripts/photo_coverage.py): for every feature, how well the photos can pin it down. Grades: unseen, seen, located (direction), fixed (position and depth), measured (a recorded measured approval). `computed` is what the photos alone support; `grade` adds cited photos and measured approvals. Coverage says what the photos could support. It is not a measurement and grants no placement approval.

grades.meaning: No photo sees it: hidden in every view, or nobody has stood where it shows.
A photo shows it, but no solved camera within 25 m: what it looks like, not where it is.
A solved camera sees it within 25 m: its direction is fixed, its depth is not.
Position and depth: two solved views at least 30 degrees apart, one solved view close by of its foot, or one plus the aerial.
A recorded measured approval: two solved cameras or one plus the aerial, 0.3 m rms, second-agent review.
